svg.aria-label: Dual-judge calibration slopegraph and severity gap analysis between claude-opus-5.5 and gpt-5.5
svg.text: Dual-Judge Calibration Audit · claude-opus-5.5 Judge vs. gpt-5.5 Judge Across 223 Deliverables
How Averaging Two Judges Cancels a 14.7-Point Severity Gap and a 4.1-Point Family Preference
Left: Rank & score shift when graded solely by Opus 5.5 vs. solely by GPT-5.5. Right: Judge severity gap by creative task and relative self-family tilt.
A. Judge Score by Task: Opus 5.5 (Amber) vs. GPT-5.5 (Blue)
Opus is 14.7 pts harsher overall — widest on SVG Diagram (-22.1) & 3D (-20.6)
B. Judge Gap by Model Family (Opus Score − GPT Score)
Opus is -12.0 pts on Claude vs. -16.2 on GPT (+4.1 pt self-family tilt)
★ Key Insight: 50/50 Dual-Judge Average Neutralizes Family Tilt (±2.0 pts)
Note: Left slopegraph compares Q_Opus = 0.4×Auto + 0.6×Judge_Opus against Q_GPT = 0.4×Auto + 0.6×Judge_GPT. Amber curves shift up under Opus; blue curves shift up under GPT.
